post_subline: Your friends don't need Glamis Guide installed. One tap opens it instantly, with directions straight to your camp.
caption:
Share your camp location with anyone, even if they don't have Glamis Guide.
One tap opens a lightweight version of the app instantly. No download.
Directions take them straight to your camp.
Free on the App Store. Link in bio.
